data.narrative:
AtmoCooling is a Seed-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Paul Mahacek and Paul-Emmanuel Herve that has raised $3.6M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises nine private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and one public comparable (LNZA), though the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage datapoints for reliable median-based valuation.

The Stage-Progression method is the applicable triangulation approach. Using the $3.6M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a typical 2.5x multiplier for progression from Seed to the next funding stage yields an implied valuation of $9M. This represents the primary quantitative anchor given the absence of narrow-set peer multiples.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $8M (low) to $10M (high), with a median of $9M. Key uncertainties include the limited peer universe at identical stage and valuation tier—nine Climate & Energy competitors exist but none provide sufficiently comparable data to cross-check the stage-progression result. Any future valuation refinement would benefit from establishing tighter peer comparables or obtaining direct market intelligence on recent Seed-to-Series A step-ups within the sector.
